import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    base = int(input_data[0])
    number = int(input_data[1])
    result = True

    while number > 0:
        remainder = number % base
        if remainder == 0 or remainder - 1 == 0:
            number //= base
        elif remainder + 1 == base:
            number += 1
        else:
            result = False
            break

    print("YES" if result else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
